name: Haus Sattelkopf
beschreibung: The Haus Sattelkopf is set on a sunny, peaceful hillside in picturesque St. Jakob, perched slightly above the lively centre of St. Anton am Arlberg. Decorated in an alpine timber aesthetic, the comfortable guest rooms provide en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies that showcase magnificent panoramas across the Arlberg and Verwall mountain ranges. A nutritious breakfast buffet filled with local delicacies is prepared every morning in the cosy dining area. The free ski bus stops just steps away, bringing winter sport fans to the main cable car terminals of Galzig, Gampen, and Rendl within Ski Arlberg in minutes. In summer, exhilarating climbing routes, alpine hikes, and biking circuits begin nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy guesthouse on a peaceful hillside in St. Jakob near St. Anton am Arlberg with balcony rooms and swift access to Ski Arlberg.
